fieldworkDocument.title: Bàs is Adhlacadh / Death and Burial
fieldworkDocument.note: [NOTES: the words have been slipped and therefore, apart from the definitions provided by the informant, the definitions as they appear on the slips have also been included (unless the two were the same).]

item.description: [NOTES: slipped under ‘caochail’. Definition: Never ‘bhàsaich’ for a person. chaochail, shiubhail, dh’falbh [sic].]
[NOTES: slipped under ‘siubhal’. Definition: chaochail, shiubhail, dh’fhalbh. Never ‘bhàsaich’ for a person.]
[NOTES: slipped under ‘falbh’. Definition: chaochail, shiubhail, dh’fhalbh. Never ‘bhàsaich’ for a person.]
never for a person. [NOTES: slip not found.]
Ag cur a’ chuirp ’sa’ chiste cha bhiodh ann ach “na bha de’n fhuil” – is e sin am facal a chuala mi. [NOTES: slip not found.]
an carbad agus an luchd-giùlain. A’ dol a steach geata a’ chlaidh rachadh daoine a bhuineadh dha fo’n ghiùlan.
nùr fail cho fada ris an uaigh rachadh a chur air a h-uachdar. An rud mu dheireadh. “Dh’fhurich sinn gus an do chuir iad am fàilean air.”
